name: CreditCardApplication
description: The credit card application record. Created by SVC-003 (Credit Card Service) at PH-023 when a customer submits an application. Tracks the application lifecycle from submission through to approval or decline. References the selected CardProduct (ENT-024) and the resulting CreditCardAccount (ENT-023) on approval.

fields.name: application_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Must reference an active Customer. Immutable.

fields.name: product_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → CardProduct.product_id (ENT-024). Must reference an active CardProduct at time of submission. Immutable.

fields.name: requested_limit
fields.validation_rule: Optional. GBP. Min £250.00, max £50,000.00 if provided. Null if customer did not specify.

fields.name: income_declared
fields.validation_rule: Required. Gross annual income in GBP. Used for CONC 5.3A creditworthiness assessment.

fields.name: employment_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: employed_full_time | employed_part_time | self_employed | retired | student | unemployed | other.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: submitted | assessment_complete | approved | declined | referred | withdrawn.

fields.name: credit_assessment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. UUID. Set when EVT-042 consumed. Reference to SVC-012 assessment (for CCA s157 right-to-know).

fields.name: assigned_credit_limit
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. GBP. Set at PH-025 on approval. Null before decision.

fields.name: decision
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Enum: approved | declined | referred. Null before PH-025 completes.

fields.name: decision_timestamp
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when decision is made.

fields.name: resulting_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. FK → CreditCardAccount.account_id (ENT-023). Set at PH-026 on approved path.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: CreditCardApplication belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK.
CreditCardApplication references one CardProduct via product_id FK.
On approval, one CreditCardApplication results in one CreditCardAccount.

design_decisions.decision: income_declared is self-declared and unverified — consistent with CONC 5.3A which permits proportionate creditworthiness assessment for standard credit cards.
design_decisions.rationale: CONC 5.3A permits proportionate assessment. Self-declared income with cross-check against bureau data is FCA-accepted for personal credit cards.

design_decisions.decision: Raw credit score is not stored on ENT-022. Only credit_assessment_reference (pointer to SVC-012 record) is held.
design_decisions.rationale: UK GDPR data minimisation (Article 5(1)(c)). Reference is sufficient for CCA s157 right-to-know disclosure.
